newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Jan motorcycle output rises 5.4% yr/yr -JAMA.
newsitem.headline: Japan Jan motorcycle output rises 5.4% yr/yr -JAMA.

text.p: Japan's motorcycle production rose 5.4 percent in January from a year earlier to 209,858 units, the Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association (JAMA) said on Monday.
It was the first rise in four months on a year-on-year basis.

Domestic motorcycle sales fell 7.1 percent in January from a year earlier to 74,817 units.
The association expects Japan's motorcycle exports to rise about one percent in January from a year earlier. JAMA plans to announce official export figures on February 26.
